cohort: single H100 80GB, 8 distinct physical cores in one NUMA domain, quota >=8
baseline: same-repeat new Pipeline for +5% CPD/WL and new performance ratios
qual: three fresh pre-formal qualifications; compare full ALT captures and maps against fixed original digests
formal: fresh original native VPR; no capture or verification; zero overuse, FULL/STA, digest-stable own route
time: E2 and Process as frozen in 30bc113; independent readback sequential, outside both
ratio: mean and sample SD of 3 within-repeat time ratios; no ratios for incomplete or failed cases
BNN_admission: after GEMM: use prior BNN 12 main plus readback durations scaled by observed GEMM elapsed relative to corresponding historical arms, 20% margin plus 120s
retry: at most one documented orchestration recovery within original budget; no timing-based retries
